primary.metric: full-vocabulary first-byte accuracy; exact 4-byte recall, complete maps and absence reported separately

wrong_history: same temporary keys, different source quotes; first answer class shifted by 1 for every key; correct labels remain original history
query_swap: query another present key but score against original label; raw output retained
present_first_class_balance: exactly equal a-h across 24 histories for each load; 12.5% constant-class baseline
source: DEV only; held-out key families; no model-facing key parser or oracle write masks
decision: All gates must pass for narrow supervised query-dependent retrieval claim. Otherwise report failures by seed/condition; no capacity verdict. Gates do not qualify architecture superiority.
source_lm: Same 8192 fresh 128-byte original DEV targets as C14; separate 16 contiguous 512-byte windows carry vs reset
logging: All query predictions and source offsets; full 256 logits retained for primary normal/wrong/reset. Shared histories reused across arms/seeds.
